{{Top|leg}}
The '''Mission to the Reo system''' was a mission undertaken by the [[New Jedi Order]] to learn information on the entity [[Abeloth]] from the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] hive in the [[Reo system/Legends|system]]. The mission was given to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Raynar Thul]], [[Tekli]] and [[Lowbacca]].<ref name=":0">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>

The Jedi successfully found the [[Thuruht]] hive, and were able to find the knowledge needed thanks to the [[Thuruht Queen]], but only upon [[Raynar Thul]]'s agreement to become a [[Joiner]] for the hive, and prepare for what they described as, "The end of days." Tekli and Lowbacca returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to share their knowledge with the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]] and [[Club Bwua'tu]], which would be integral in Abeloth's defeat by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name=":0" />
